title: Resolved images of a protostellar outflow driven by an extended disk wind
question: Where in the protostellar disk is the TMC1A CO outflow launched, and is it an extended disk wind or an X-wind/stellar wind?

what.value: Protostar mass ~0.5 Msun, disk mass 0.05 Msun, inclination 55°, disk radius 200 au

evidence.quote: a disk-like structure of radius 200 au which is inclined 55° with respect to the plane of the sky [14]

what.value: Systemic velocity 6.4 km/s and outflow position angle ~165°

evidence.quote: with position angle ~165° east of north.

recipe.method: CASA calibration, uv continuum subtraction, CLEAN with tapers
key_parameters: robust 0.5 continuum; natural for lines; taper 0.04''/0.10''

recipe.goal: Identify origin of 12CO emission and disk Keplerian rotation
recipe.method: Compare isotopologues, estimate optical depths, simulate Keplerian disk, fit 2D Gaussians to 13CO/C18O channels for peak positions to derive central mass
assumptions: Kinetic temperature 100 K; isotopic ratios 60 (13CO) and 550 (C18O); i=55±10°

recipe.method: Flux-weighted first-order polynomial z=A(r−r0) fit to 12CO pixels above midplane per channel, eastern side only
key_parameters: S/N>3; velocities 2 to 5.5 km/s from systemic

recipe.method: Eq. 4 of Anderson et al. 2003 applied per pixel using velocity field decomposed into rotation and outflow components, masking where escape velocity exceeds outflow velocity
assumptions: vφ = vlos/sin(i)/2, vout = vlos/cos(i)/2; outflow perpendicular to disk, symmetric

recipe.method: Gaussian fit of deprojected radial continuum profile, excluding 12–33 au; specific angular momentum = rotational velocity × distance to axis

evidence.quote: reveal a range of footpoint radii between ~6 and ~22 au
revealing footpoint radii between ~2 and ~19 au (Fig. 3)
The central mass is estimated at 0.4±0.1 _M_ sun
we calculate the optical depths (𝜏) to be 0.04, 0.2 and 25 for C [18] O, [13] CO and [12] CO
to be less than 200 au km s [−1] in the outflow
is located at a relatively constant radius of ~20 au

not_stated_but_needed: Clean threshold, niter, masks, cell and image size
Details of the non-LTE model and disk model parameters
Choice of fitted pixel sets and weights in the footpoint fit
Calibrator flux values and CASA calibration script
score_reason: Data public and method clear, but imaging details and analysis code missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric footpoint radii, simple fitting recipe.
